name: Qinhuangdao Port Co., Ltd.
summary: Qinhuangdao Port Co., Ltd. provides integrated port services in Mainland China. The company offers highly integrated and comprehensive port services, including stevedoring, stacking, warehousing, transportation, discharging, container stacking, container load, and logistics services; and handles various types of cargoes comprising coal, metal ores, oil and liquefied chemicals, containers, and general cargoes. It also provides ancillary port services, such as tallying and trans-shipping services.
